ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.

6. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.

7. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.

8. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. going
   D. goes

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. run

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Plot.

13. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

14. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.

15. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.5.1 Narrative and Descriptive Paragraphs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
